title: Assert clean real-proxy shutdowns emit no daemon recovery warning
outcome: The real-process recovered and never-recovered shutdown controls check their captured stderr as well as exit status, exposing any spurious recovery cleanup warning.
acceptance: Existing real-proxy recovered-clean (exit 0) and never-recovered (exit 4) shutdown cases assert the captured stderr contains no Phoenix warning: daemon recovery line, while still checking their exit codes and retaining process cleanup.

completion.summary: All3 actual-proxy shutdown cases now assert stderr has no Phoenix warning: daemon recovery prefix as well as exact exit status. Synthetic-warning mutant failed all3; removed. Implemented and full-union reviewed; not committed or pushed.
